Every full input cell produces exact row entropy e_s(j), and the unique straddling cell has the explicitly derived two-branch overlapping output masses u_k. The resulting finite N formula, e_s(j+s)=e_s(j), and exact N-to-N+L recurrence establish all quantifiers. value.rationale: Finite-grid entropy from a previously studied dynamical-noise model has an exact arithmetic phase correction of optimal 1/N order, computable without asymptotic approximation. The correction reverses sign on two infinite residue classes for one natural rational skew tent map, so finite resolution can overshoot the zero-noise entropy. The structural result solves a motivated finite-resolution bias question across all rational two-branch parameters, not an arbitrary fixed numerical slice.
